content.markdown:
**V1.4.18** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on May 6th, 2022.

## V1.4.18

- Feature - Bridge Train Track Tiles ([#3507](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/3507) [#2197](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2197) [#1090](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/1090))
- Feature - Expanded Addon Lua pathfinding ([#7030](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7030))

- Rework - Client movement now always uses client camera direction instead of server authored direction
- Fix - [#3873](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/3873) Suspension rendering when flipped
- Fix - [#3904](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/3904) Jet Exhaust rendering when flipped
- Fix - [#1840](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/1840) Pick-block raycast not accounting for sub-mesh offsets
- Fix - [#4570](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4570) SRB fin mirroring issues
- Fix - [#6426](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/6426) [#6877](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/6877) Hotkeys still activating when typing in a text field
- Fix - [#6558](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/6558) Removed ability to place C4 on characters
- Fix - [#6295](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/6295) Improved voice listener position data when transmitting audio
- Fix - [#7218](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7218) Assorted typos
- Fix - [#7113](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7113) Can't spawn mission editor test on Mac
- Fix - [#7100](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7100) Vehicle editor allowing multi-body components to go beyond bounds
- Fix - [#7099](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7099) Cleaned up old Bugsplat files
- Fix - [#7077](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7077) [#7256](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7256) Reworked ?reload_scripts so that it now correctly reloads workshop addons. Removed unused addon data from scene.xml.
- Fix - [#7074](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7074) Documented server.dlcWeapons()
- Fix - [#7056](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7056) Fixed empty inventory names
- Fix - [#7054](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7054) Heli rotor blades wrongly detected by lasers when folded
- Fix - [#6967](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/6967) Respawn button not getting un-focused with controller
- Fix - [#6895](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/6895) No underwater effect with window when shooting underwater
- Fix - [#6884](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/6884) Updated description for onButtonPress callback to be clearer about its function
- Fix - [#6826](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/6826) Different cameras in sealed container behave incorrectly while submerged
- Fix - [#4951](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/4951) Wind direction not updating correctly
- Fix - [#2898](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2898) Robotic hinge rendering in select mode
- Fix - [#2467](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2467) Unconscious characters imparting force when loading a save
- Fix - [#2142](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2142) Coal does not get refunded when despawning a Vehicle
- Fix - [#2126](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2126) Ammo Belts not refunding when editing a vehicle
- Fix - [#2003](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/2003) Inverting radars causes them to detect behind the radar/inverted detection
- Fix - [#132](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/132) Tanks with both ports connected pressure issues
- Rework - Adjusted underwater welding brightness
- Fix - [#7250](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7250) [#7270](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7270) [#7431](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7431) Improved safeguards against logic thread freezing
- Fix - [#7253](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7253) Weapons can now fire underwater
- Fix - [#7360](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7360) Fix crouch speed horizontal movement being affected by look direction
- Fix - [#7372](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7372) Fix setVehiclePosSafe using sub-grids in bounds calculations
- Fix - [#7379](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7379) Fix component inventory sometimes rendering incorrectly
- Fix - [#7485](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7485) Robotic door hinge tooltip
- Fix - Crash caused by invalid logic slot data
- Fix - Lua vehicle spawning failing occasionally when the spawn point is very far from any islands
- Fix - [#7625](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7625) Updated propeller sounds
- Fix - [#7532](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7532) Added buoyancy surfaces to rotor/prop hubs
- Fix - [#7576](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7576) Removed animation from component inventory
- Fix - Ai boats no longer initialize with a path that leads them straight ahead (into islands)
- Rework - Reduced max particle buffer size to save memory
- Fix - Updated dedicated server default playlists to include all playlists
- Fix - Weather overrides now parse correctly

Addon Lua Changes:

Added *{ = {x = world_x, z = world_z} } = server.pathfind(matrix_start, matrix_end, required_tags, avoided_tags)* Passing "ocean_path" as a required tag will produce the same behavior as server.pathfindOcean.

Default Ai addons now navigate different paths based on their size. Large ships can no longer path through the sawyer river or under standard train bridge tiles.

Waypoint offsets are now randomized within the game code and can be adjusted by providing a "precision=X" tag which will confine the randomness within X metres of the node. As an example we have included this tag on all bridge waypoints in the default_paths playlist.

## Source

- [Steam Community News](https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/573090/view/3220647375541474071?l=english)
